note: One override, for debt. Upbound carries its entire borrowing in two lines the concept passes cannot see: upbd:SecuredDebtNet and upbd:SeniorNotesNet, both in its own extension namespace. The companyfacts API publishes only dei, srt and us-gaap, so neither exists there, and adding them to the shared vocabulary would achieve nothing -- there is no fact to read. The rendered balance sheet does carry extension elements, which is what this binding reads. The only us-gaap debt concept Upbound ever tagged is LongTermDebt, last used in 2016; every year after it the row went empty while the company carried $1.5B, and total debt, net cash and enterprise value went with it. Everything else about this filer resolves from the global tier and is deliberately left alone.

metrics.label: Senior debt, net
metrics.note: The term-loan facility. $1,126,030 thousand at FY2025.

metrics.label: Senior notes, net
metrics.note: The unsecured note issue. $443,854 thousand at FY2025.

metrics.label: Long-Term Debt
metrics.note: Summed, because Upbound tags no total: the two lines above are the whole of it, and either alone reports a fraction. Scoped from FY2017 so it starts exactly where us-gaap:LongTermDebt stops -- that concept is legitimately Upbound's own figure through FY2016 and is left to resolve normally there. The scope is also what stops the overlay clearing those earlier years: a derived binding metric otherwise owns its whole row, which is right for a redefinition like UNTA and wrong for a metric declaring it covers only part of the history. zero_if_absent because a year with only one of the two lines is still that year's debt. Operating lease liabilities are deliberately excluded, matching the app-wide decision to keep them off total debt and enterprise value.
